segments.note: Answers Sophie's 'Christina, what do you think?' in first person (distant relatives / cousins / same year).
Continuation of her answer.
Continuation of her answer.
'we go to school but we're very different groups' — elaborating the cousins-but-not-close dynamic.
Sophie says 'correct me if you think I'm wrong here, Christina' — softening 'aggressive' to 'passionate' is her reply.
Ack bridging into her character description.
'I was thinking mine was going to be pretty skeptical in like a more quiet like' — describing HER character.
Continuation: 'suspicious but'.
Continuation ack.
'mine... she's a little bit quieter... wary of Harmony... going to uncover the conspiracy' — defining her character's worldview.
low-confidence: 'Hell yeah' to Sophie's shared-backstory proposal.
'Um, not officially yet' — answering 'does your character have a name?'
'We're waiting for the names to come to' (continues into 411).
'us.' — end of the names answer.
'my character would be kind of like looking for... a darker corner' — describing her character's arrival reaction.
Continuation: darker/safe spot, 'she like kind of waddles off'.
'spot.' — tail of her answer.
'Uh, shapewise turtle,' — answering 'more turtle or more fungus?'
mushroom-side colors/textures + 'the only thing that I've really decided on my character is... the red and'.
'white spotted mushroom.'
'that you drop into when you get I can turtle and like suck into'.
'the paci.' — shell detail continuation.
'Is it soft? Is it like a harder shell? I don't know.' — self-questioning design talk.
'I'm kind of leaning on the mushroom side...' — design lean.
'We'll see what your classes are...' — deferring design to class choice.
'the only other character detail I need is like do we have huge eyes... Medium small.' — self-answering design riff.
'Okay.' — closing the design beat.
